messages:
maria: Follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem  need final owners + short deadlines for customer comms and a recurring-incident note. Items: status page blurb, 72h public summary, and RCA-sharing policy (redaction + consent). Who takes which?

ben: Ill do the status page blurb. Will draft a 1-line TL;DR + one "what were doing" bullet. Draft by 2026-03-27 EOD and post here.

liz: Ill co-own the 72h summary with Nina; Ill handle tone/legal. Target 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC. Legal: no customer names/IDs/screenshots in public.

sam: Ill own the RCA sharing policy + consent flow. Deliverables: redaction checklist, brief consent form, and access matrix (public summary / impacted customers / internal). Due 2026-03-25 COB.

nina: Ill run the recurring-pattern blurb and link remediation tracker. Noting 2 similar routing-policy regressions in last 90 days; recommend a routing-audit and a pre-rollout checklist. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: I added action items into the postmortem tracker. Please verify. Snippet I pasted into the doc: ```- Status page blurb  owner: ben  due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- 72h public summary  owners: liz, nina  due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC
- RCA sharing policy + consent flow  owner: sam  due: 2026-03-25 COB
- Remediation rollout update  owner: eng-sre  due: 2026-04-02```

ben: Draft status text: "We experienced a brief period of request throttling caused by a misapplied quota routing rule. Impact: small subset of requests. Mitigation: traffic reroute and hotfix. Next steps: routing guard + improved monitoring. POC: incidents@redwood.com" Comments?

liz: Edit: use "brief throttling" (no internal seconds), add link to live status page, and a short "what were doing to prevent recurrence" bullet list. Remove any customer identifiers.

sam: For detailed RCA access: propose a simple consent checkbox + email request form; default public summary redacted. Legal: redact customer IDs/screenshots; provide detailed timeline on request and consent. Ill draft the consent language now.

nina: Uploaded recurrence analysis and added suggested wording for the 72h summary: one sentence about the pattern + planned audit. Also linked remediation tracker.

ops-bot: postmortem archived: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated.

maria: Thanks. Ill set calendar reminders and nudge owners 24h before due dates. If anyone needs to swap ownership, post here.
